title: Per-version queryCache lifecycle (TAC-4136)
description: The server closure holds queryCache as a Map keyed by state.version + route + pivot + direction|scope and replaces it wholesale on every rewalk right after state is updated, so a new state.version never serves a previous version's bytes (AC-208-6). The cache is exposed to createRouter through deps.queryCache.{get, set, has, size}; writes stay inside the closure, never persisted and never written under rcf/.
